info.title: PlaneMem current and archived context item reads
info.description: Source-only description of two existing GETs. Load this OpenAPI and adjacent context-history OpenAPI plus schemas/context-item-read.json and schemas/context-history.json locally, preserving relative paths and schema IDs. Shared auth/header/error components are reused without changing history routes. No generated-client compatibility or runtime evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure actual origin and base path.

x-source-boundaries.description: JSON size budgets and the SDK's default 30-second wait are client/shared-parser boundaries, not uniform HTTP response or total server request limits. Legacy GET handlers do not call the full shared parser or provide a dedicated two-slot gate, total deadline, post-read expiry check or guaranteed SQL cancellation. Current source traversal has separate graph budgets: loads in batches of 64, marks nodes with >32 sources invalid, and reports traversal exhaustion as limit. Strict and ordinary evaluations share the work budget. These do not bound complete row bytes, response serialization or database work.

x-http-input: Only item_id is accepted and comes from the decoded path. Both GETs reject all URL query parameters. GET bodies are not parsed or explicitly rejected by dedicated framing guards. Generic If-Match and If-Match-Version must parse and agree if supplied, but do not condition the read. Idempotency-Key does not cache/replay these reads. Range/cache conditions have no implemented 206/304 behavior; no strict blanket header rejection is claimed.

get.summary: Read the current nonarchived item with live local-source observations
get.description: Authorize context.read through Policy, then read item, saved confirmation and local-source graph inside one repeatable-read read-only transaction. Require a nondeleted visible parent project and nonarchived visible item; both parent and item restricted classifications require actual data.restricted.read. Current means nonarchived, not necessarily fresh, confirmed or unexpired. Recursively follow only exact context-item sources in the authorized project, at pinned positive revisions; evaluate lifecycle, readability, classification ordering, cycles and dependency confirmation. Other source types cause no external fetch. Failed or exhausted source checks are successful detail observations with sources_current=false, not authorization failures or partial-source success. Per-source diagnostics identify root source positions, not hidden descendants. Confirmed items can have null confirmation when no confirm history exists; recorded confirmation is checked against the current version snapshot.
get.x-confirmation-hint: confirmation_readiness is produced only for proposed items and a verified human client with context.review or admin role. Passing it requires at least one source and all local descendants confirmed, using the same graph/check timestamp as ordinary inspection. External sources remain manual evidence. confirm_allowed additionally requires readiness.sources_current=true and effective expiry null or still in the future when constructing the response. This is a local hint, not a write Policy/OPA decision, lock, reservation or proof it will still be allowed at submission.

200.description: Complete current document and local-source observations, outer version-derived weak ETag/revision and exact sources. No archived_at or server_cursor. Optional source_checks/readiness remain optional in the shared schema for compatibility; the current Gateway requests direct diagnostics. Saved data.trace_id can differ from this read's outer trace.

get.description: Use context.read Policy plus the same visible nondeleted parent and item classification filters. The selected current row must have a nonnull archive timestamp; an active row is 404, with no fallback between views. Returns its saved excluded document and archive time, without local-source traversal, confirmation metadata or review hints. This is the currently archived row, not an arbitrary historical version. A repeatable-read read-only transaction covers the read. ETag describes this item version for explicit later version-bound workflows, not authorization to restore or proof of current sources.

200.description: Complete archived document, archived_at, outer revision/weak etag and exact original sources. No live checks, confirmation/readiness, confirm_allowed or server_cursor. The shared parser requires excluded status; Gateway retains its narrower stored-metadata checks.

ItemEtag.description: Exactly matches outer etag and buildEtag(data.version); outer revision=data.version. Weak version tag does not change solely because dependency freshness, permissions or wall-clock expiry change. No If-None-Match/304 support is implied.

Error.description: Complete application error with open details and no fallback to the other view. Early input/authentication errors may omit x-trace-id and WWW-Authenticate; parser/proxy errors before the application can use another representation.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for malformed item ID/path encoding or any URL query. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed or inconsistent generic version headers. retryable=false. GET body framing is not explicitly rejected by these handlers.

Denied.description: DENIED for unauthorized scope, expected identity or Policy decision; retryable=false. Policy context.read allows its existing admin bypass, but restricted SQL filters require actual data.restricted.read. No separate verified-client requirement for either read; readiness has stronger requirements. Missing/invisible parent or item is 404.

NotFound.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_NOT_FOUND for missing/deleted/invisible parent, missing/invisible item, archived row on current path or active row on archived path; retryable=false. No silent view switching.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED from general actor/path limiter; retryable=true. No dedicated detail two-slot error or Retry-After guarantee.

InvalidStored.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_INVALID for stored metadata, version, confidence, source/date conversion, archive timestamp or recorded confirmation/hash checks; retryable=false. Dependency failure states normally remain observations inside HTTP 200. Gateway does not run the full shared response parser. Unexpected command-boundary INTERNAL_ERROR uses serializer default retryable=true.

Unavailable.description: CONTEXT_ITEM_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE for absent database or non-ContractError read/transaction/source-inspection failures; WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE at outer boundaries. retryable=true. Read requests do not require a write key even though the legacy generic storage message mentions retrying with a request key.
